integration.route: designer route kept; local repair around each trimmed tap

sections.label: Intro riff
sections.note: Beat-stepped NE staircase on the synth riff (one tap per beat), then two long sweeps over the start deck.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.note: Locker canyon: tight sawtooth zigzag (legs of 2-4 taps) on the dembow syncopation, narrow road 1.8, the road passes through a locker passage.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 1
sections.note: Square spiral (L) climbing +12 around the diving tower; the laps pass over each other.

sections.label: Build 1
sections.note: Short SE staircase run off the tower top; fall -4 onto the pool deck right before the chorus.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.note: Open U of staircases around the summer pool (three diagonal legs); five-colour pillars answer the vocal; one fake fork.

sections.label: Post-chorus 1
sections.note: Switchbacks down the bridge (lanes on the longer gaps), climbing +4; the sports-hall gate wraps one lane.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.note: Diamond staircase loop around the sports court (four legs); the road closes the loop at a different height.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 2
sections.note: Fall -5 into the phone patio: a tight 2-tap zigzag corridor between phone screens (road 1.7); E1 flip phone.

sections.label: Build 2
sections.note: Jump +3 onto the bridge deck B2, sparse build taps.

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.note: One long sweeping NE staircase over the whole map (ramp +3) - the longest diagonal of the level.

sections.label: Final chorus
sections.note: Spiral staircase: five diagonal legs rotating around the five-colour pillar ring while climbing +6, crossing over its own start.

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: Calm straight to the finish deck, little white bunny echo.
